sources.entry: Pulse - AI-moderated market research platform that runs customer interviews at scale. #paid

summary.name: Pulse
summary.one_liner: Pulse is an online market research platform that runs AI-moderated voice, video, and UX interviews with customers and returns a themed report with quotes.
use_cases: Interviewing customers who churned to learn why
Testing a product or prototype with a screen-share UX study
Researching fintech and payments customer behaviour
Recruiting participants for a market research study
Grouping customer interview answers into themes with quotes
Building a searchable library of past customer research
summary.what_it_does: Pulse takes a research question, builds a brief with audience and screener, and recruits participants matching the profile or invites the user's own customers. An AI moderator conducts voice, video, or screen-share interviews, asking follow-up questions based on the participant's answers. Results are returned as themes grouped by what people said, with supporting quotes and transcripts. The page also describes tone marking on voice answers, facial expression scoring on video, and an insights library across studies. Surveys and integrations are mentioned as additional platform features.
notable: AI moderator probes and adapts follow-up questions in the participant's own words
Voice answers tagged with tone; video adds facial expression scoring
Interviews available in 240+ languages on request
Insights library makes findings queryable across projects
caveats: Listed as paid in the source directory
Languages beyond the default are enabled on request
Page does not state specific pricing tiers
